hook: Only your Front Lemming speaks: set the queue of leaders, and each death passes the Banner on.
loop: Set your Front for plays, sells and End of Turn.
Raise the Banner and order a queue of leaders, Kits as timers.
In the fight, each death passes the Banner; Take the Lead fires.

growth.line: Banner climbs slowly each turn; Cantor adds 2 per death; Onward gives it to every Lemming.

feel.early: Plain bodies; one text at a time; Kits for gold.
feel.mid: Banner grows; Trailbreaker and Herald make the queue matter.
feel.late: Banner cascades down the line; Onward or Lemen cash in.

stars.why: Makes enemies hit your Front, so you set who dies first.
The lead visibly changes hands, buffing the next leader.
Pays the whole game's Banner to every Lemming at once.

card_short.u13: Start of Combat: fills empty slots after it with Kits.

card_short.x01: Blank 1/1 Lemming token: a spacer, timer and cheap death.

builds.name: The Cliff Cult
builds.line: Gerd sets the death order, Cantor grows Banner, Onward cashes it late.

builds.name: The Matriarch
builds.line: Lemen leads from the back row behind other tribes; Kits copy her.

builds.name: The Relay
builds.line: The Front Lemming doubles Take the Lead; Trailbreakers and Herald repeat it.

liked: All three: no tribe plays like this; slot order becomes a queue of leaders.
Gerd and Trailbreaker stood out: you choose who leads and who dies first.
worries: Watch: The Front Lemming, Cantor and golden Brother Onward stack to about ×4.
Watch: Old Mother Lemen's Kit copies are a huge high roll that crashes.
changed: Added Loud: Digger, Council and Kit-Minder now work from any slot.
Old Mother Lemen's Kits can't take the Front from her, so her build works.
Tally became a non-Lemming fox, so the early gold needs no Front swap.
verdict: Ordering-puzzle lovers will enjoy lining up a queue of leaders and choosing who falls first.
